tbpn_example.episode_title: xAI merges with X, Isomorphic Labs raises $600M (Aaron Levie, Alexis Ohanian, RJ Halperin, Cristobal Valenzuela, David Zagaynov, Sam Lessin)

notes: Start (step 1): read SPEC.md, AGENT_BRIEF.md, the minto-scqa registry entry (slots situation/complication/question/answer; relations disrupted_by/raises/answered_by; layout hint tree, direction right, chain S -> C -> Q -> A) and schema.json; read toulmin-model and star-par (both done) for house style, with SPEC.md winning where they predate the current conventions (fact edges, idea field, source_ref line ranges, Example 2 section split). Research (step 2, recall): Barbara Minto, McKinsey, The Pyramid Principle (1970s course; book 1987, revised 1996): the introduction told as a story so that the reader arrives at the writer's main point with the question already in mind. Situation = a self-contained, non-controversial statement about the subject that the reader already knows and accepts (time, place, stable baseline: 'you know that...'). Complication = what happened in that situation to disturb it and create a need: something went wrong, something changed, something new arrived, someone proposed an alternative, results fell short. Question = the single question the complication raises in the reader's mind (what should we do; how do we do it; is the proposal right; why did it not work); usually implicit, never more than one. Answer = the main point, the governing thought at the top of the pyramid; stated in a written memo, and it raises a new question (why? how?) answered by the key line, which is where the Pyramid Principle proper takes over. Minto's pattern table: need to do task / something prevents / what to do; have problem / know solution / how to implement; have problem / solution proposed / is it right; took action / did not work / why not; took action / worked / how to get more. Orders: standard S-C-A, direct A-S-C, concerned C-S-A, aggressive Q-S-C-A. Common misuse: situation that smuggles in the complication or the answer; a complication that is a list of problems with no single question; a question the answer does not answer; an answer that is a topic ('our pricing') rather than a point; assuming the reader accepts a contested situation; the question left so vague that any answer fits. Provenance expectation: situation and complication are usually stated (speakers narrate how it was and what changed); the question is almost never stated (derived, high confidence when the complication is sharp); the answer is stated when the speaker is pitching (fact) but the answer at the level of the question, or the resolution of a discussion nobody closed, is derived. Idea-bearing slot candidate: answer (the resolution a complication forces is the pitch), to be confirmed after the scout. Scout (step 3): three candidates returned, all outside the two episodes already used by siblings (2025-11-19 Hutchins for toulmin-model, 2025-07-14 Windsurf for star-par): (1) Poseidon / David Zagaynov, the ekranoplan 'flying boats' pitch, 2025-03-31; (2) Arena AI / Pratap Ranade, Atlas AI hardware engineer, 2025-04-08; (3) Orchid Health / Noor Siddiqui, whole-genome embryo screening, 2025-08-18. Chose (1) Poseidon: the founder narrates the whole SCQA in sequence in one contiguous passage (L5614-L5698) - a hundred-year-stable logistics baseline, two distinct complications (the Soviet ekranoplan blockers dissolved by composites and modern controls; ground-effect craft fall under the Coast Guard and IMO rather than the FAA), and a one-sentence governing thought ('So what we're building are flying boats') with hard numbers later (50 ft, two tons, a quarter to a third of air-freight price per kg-mile). Decisive for this library: TWO questions are spoken aloud in the passage and NEITHER is the Minto question - the founder voices a premature search question raised by the situation alone (L5630) and a host voices a 'why now' question about the complication (L5802-L5808) - so the graph can show fact question nodes beside the derived one and make the framework's signature provenance point visible. (2) was a close second (canonical unstated question, sharpest numbers) and is the fallback if a reviewer rejects (1). Decision: idea_bearing_slot = question, not answer as the research step guessed: in a TBPN founder pitch the answer is almost always stated (a fact node, and facts may not carry an idea), while the question the complication forces is the slot that names the underserved need and generalises into a market screen. Graph (step 4): validate.mjs PASS, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 paraphrases; every quote extracted from the transcript by line range with a script that asserts the normalised span is present in the source, so no quote was typed by hand. classic = 10 nodes (7 fact / 3 derived), 14 edges (4 fact / 10 derived): an original Minto-pattern memo scenario (Fielding Instruments) written so that the Question is genuinely absent from the source text - the narration says only that she never puts the question on the page - which keeps the framework's signature slot derived. tbpn = 21 nodes (16 fact / 5 derived), 33 edges (4 fact / 29 derived). Design decisions: (a) added a fourth relation, elaborates, to the registry's three, because SCQA slots hold several statements each and the intra-slot structure (c3 explains why c2 matters, a2 and a3 are the same answer at different scales) has nowhere else to go; the registry's slot ids and its three relations are unchanged. (b) The question slot carries two fact nodes (q0, the founder's premature search question raised by the situation alone, and q1, the host's spoken why-now question) beside two derived ones (q2, the Minto question; q3, the generalised market screen). Both spoken questions are answered by something other than the Answer - q1 by two complication facts (e19, e20) - which is the clearest way to show why the Minto question has to be derived even in a transcript full of question marks. (c) Fact edges are only the four where one speaker states the connection in a single contiguous span; every cross-speaker link and every narrative-order link is derived per SPEC 3, which is why the derived-edge count is high. (d) idea fields sit on q2 (0.85, the coastal-freight lane) and q3 (0.6, the cheaper-certifier screen), both in the idea-bearing slot.
